semantics.decision_rule: Explanation references exact governance decision identity.
semantics.condition_rule: Relevant evaluated conditions and non-sensitive values/categories are explicit.
semantics.denial_rule: Explanation for denial avoids leaking protected denied data or secret policy internals where unsafe.
semantics.derived_rule: Explanation is evidence/projection and does not replace the decision.
semantics.model_rule: AI-generated narrative may summarize explanation but cannot invent policy causes.

invariants.rule: Policy, decision, evidence, audit record, consent, incident and compliance result remain separate machine-significant identities; no evidence artifact silently becomes source data, authorization or runtime authority.

Ambiguous or unresolved governance for protected data fails closed; UI visibility, transport reachability, cache presence, role title, prior access or audit-log presence never substitute for an explicit valid policy decision.
